hero.title:
Government schemes,
without the bureaucracy.
hero.subtitle: Describe your situation once. Five specialized AI agents find the scholarships, pensions, and benefits you actually qualify for — with explainable verdicts, a document checklist, and links you can trust.

agentsSection.title: Five agents, one journey
agentsSection.intakeDesc: Merges your form answers with facts mined from a free-text note — "my father passed away last year" becomes structured profile data.
agentsSection.discoveryDesc: Searches the indexed scheme database — central and state — for everything that could apply to you.
agentsSection.eligibilityDesc: Runs a deterministic rule engine, never an AI guess. Every verdict comes with its reasons; every unknown becomes a question, not a rejection.
agentsSection.documentDesc: Builds one consolidated checklist across all your matched schemes and marks what you already have.
agentsSection.verificationDesc: Every link comes from a curated official-source database with a last-verified date — never generated, never guessed.

howSection.title: Three steps to your benefits
howSection.step1Desc: A short form — every field optional — plus a box for anything in your own words. Speak naturally; the agents do the structuring.
howSection.step2Desc: Discovery, eligibility, documents, verification — live, in real time. No black box: you see every check and every reason.
howSection.step3Desc: Matched schemes with benefits, reasons, your missing documents, and the verified official portal to apply on.

trust.rulesDesc: Eligibility is decided by explainable rules evaluated in code. The AI helps you describe yourself — it never decides your fate.
trust.linksDesc: Every URL is curated from official government sources and re-verified with a dated stamp. LLMs never write links here.
trust.honestDesc: We tell you when a verdict depends on something you haven't confirmed — and exactly what document settles it.

footer.disclaimer: Results are indicative — final eligibility is decided by the concerned department.
